epic_board.name: EACPP Product Team Epic Board
epic_board.jql: project in (20221) AND issuetype in (10000) AND labels = "acp-product-team" ORDER BY Rank ASC

columns.strategy: One column per D0-D4 SDD gate. An epic's Jira status IS its gate.
columns.gate_source: specs/epic-mapping.json on origin/main (a gate counts once merged), synced by scripts/sync_epic_gates.py
columns.constraint: Jira board columns can only map to statuses, and the EACPP Epic workflow has exactly these six. Real D0-D4 statuses would need a Jira site admin.

api.note: Column layout is not exposed by the public REST API; use the internal greenhopper endpoints.

stories_board.name: EACPP Product Team Stories
stories_board.jql: project in (20221) AND issuetype in (10002, 10003) AND labels = "acp-product-team" ORDER BY Rank ASC

swimlanes.ordering_rules: Expedite stays first; one lane per epic in the middle; the empty-query 'Everything Else' default stays last.

api.note: Swimlanes are not exposed by the public Jira REST API; use the internal greenhopper endpoints.
api.reorder: no reorder endpoint — new lanes insert at the top; delete + recreate in reverse order to reorder

epic_lanes.rule: One lane per open epic carrying the product_team_label, ascending by key, between the two fixed lanes.
epic_lanes.excludes: Epics whose status category is 'done' (Cancelled / Done) — a closed epic gets no lane.
